profile.name: Aman Regmi
profile.bio: A passionate Full Stack Developer crafting meaningful digital experiences. I love building things that live on the internet and solving real-world problems with clean, efficient code.

projects.title: BharatpurWithMe
projects.shortDescription: A community platform connecting people in Bharatpur.
projects.description: BharatpurWithMe is a full-featured community platform designed to connect residents, tourists, and businesses in Bharatpur, Nepal. It provides local event listings, business directories, and community forums.
projects.problem: People in Bharatpur had no centralized digital platform to discover local events, find businesses, or connect with their community. Information was scattered across social media and word-of-mouth.
projects.solution: Built a centralized web platform with user authentication, event listings, business directory, and a community forum — all tailored to the Bharatpur context.
projects.contribution: I designed and developed the entire full-stack application — from database schema design, REST API development in Node.js, to the Next.js frontend and deployment.
projects.challenges: Designing a system that remains useful for both tech-savvy and non-tech users in a local Nepali context. Optimizing PostgreSQL queries for geographic filtering was also a challenge.
projects.results: Successfully launched the platform with early community adoption. Received positive feedback from local businesses and residents.

projects.title: DevTracker
projects.shortDescription: A personal project & task tracking dashboard for developers.
projects.description: DevTracker is a developer-focused project management tool that helps track tasks, deadlines, and coding sessions with a clean minimalist interface.
projects.problem: Generic project management tools like Jira feel overkill for solo developers who just need a simple way to track what they're building.
projects.solution: Built a lightweight, developer-centric tracker with GitHub integration for automatic task creation from issues.
projects.contribution: Full-stack development including Spring Boot REST API, React frontend, and PostgreSQL database design.
projects.challenges: Implementing reliable GitHub webhook integration and keeping the UI fast with real-time updates.
projects.results: Used daily for personal project management. Reduced context-switching between tools significantly.

projects.title: NepalWeather
projects.shortDescription: Localized weather app for cities across Nepal.
projects.description: A clean weather application showing real-time weather data for major cities and regions across Nepal, with a focus on local context and Nepali language support.
projects.problem: Most weather apps don't provide granular coverage for smaller cities in Nepal, and none present data in a locally relevant format.
projects.solution: Built a weather dashboard integrating OpenWeatherMap API with a curated list of Nepali locations and bilingual UI.
projects.contribution: Full frontend development with API integration and UI/UX design.
projects.challenges: Finding reliable weather data for smaller Nepali towns and handling API rate limits efficiently.
projects.results: Growing user base of Nepali users, particularly during monsoon season.

projects.title: PortfolioOS
projects.shortDescription: This very portfolio — a GBA-style interactive experience.
projects.description: The portfolio you're currently navigating. Built as an original fictional retro handheld console OS to present my digital identity in a memorable and interactive way.
projects.problem: Generic portfolio websites fail to stand out or communicate personality.
projects.solution: Designed and built an entirely original GBA-inspired interface (ByteBound OS) using pure React/CSS with no game engine.
features: Original GBA-style device frame in CSS
Web Audio API synth sound effects
projects.contribution: Concept, design, and full-stack development of the entire portfolio system.
projects.challenges: Achieving a convincing retro hardware aesthetic using only CSS. Designing a navigation system that feels intuitive across keyboard, mouse, and touch.
projects.results: A highly distinctive portfolio that communicates both technical skill and creative thinking.
